job.job_description:
Design, develop, and test backend applications using Python and FastAPI.


Collaborate with the frontend team to integrate backend services with web applications.


Develop and maintain databases using PostgreSQL.


Troubleshoot and resolve issues related to backend development.


Participate in code reviews and ensure high-quality code standards.


Work closely with the team to identify and prioritize project requirements.
